purpose: We will use regional diabetes rates to recalibrate the regional tariffs of our private health cover from next year.
question: What share of adults has type 2 diabetes in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults, adults with type 2 diabetes and the percentage, one decimal.
